company.name: Cambio
company.shortDescription: Cambio is an AI-native commercial real estate operations platform that transforms raw building data into actionable insights.
company.description: Cambio is an AI-powered commercial real estate operations platform that automates the collection, analysis, and reporting of building data to support workflows like capital planning, compliance, sustainability tracking, and retrofit planning. It uses large language models and agentic AI to ingest unstructured documents, integrate utility and performance data, and produce actionable insights and priority-ranked recommendations for property owners, asset managers, and investors. The platform consolidates disparate data into a unified system of record and generates automated reporting for regulatory and investor frameworks. Cambio also supports collaboration across teams and helps clients evaluate investment opportunities and monitor progress toward financial and performance goals.
